The '''New Republic embassy''' was the diplomatic mission of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] under [[Augwynne Djo]].

==History==
In circa [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vit]] occupied Dathomir and prevented the embassy from informed the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] of their occupation of the world.
